A2_excluded_at_1000_policies.statement: A2 is ruled out only if every repetition of the 1,000-policy cells at delegation depths 0, 1, and 2 (full path; requests rotate across all 1,000 registered, anchored policies) has p99 <= 1,000 us with zero mismatch, every stage exercised, consistent signature/cache counts, complete audit, and no non-positive sample.
